name: Warp starfield
doc: Energy accelerates the warp into long star streaks and twisted dust bands, with gold shockwaves on onsets.

speed.doc: Baseline travel speed through the star volume.

warp.doc: Weight of the fast star streams, suitable for binding to audio energy.

glow.doc: Brightness of the star cores and tails.

changelog.note: Increased warp response with beat acceleration, longer streaks and onset shockwaves.
